channel.title: Unravel Counselling: OCD and anxiety resources

item.title: Mental Compulsions in OCD: The Rituals You Cannot See
item.description: Someone can look still while spending hours reviewing, checking or trying to undo a thought. Understanding the purpose of that thinking helps explain mental compulsions.

item.title: Rumination and OCD: When Thinking Becomes a Ritual
item.description: One more replay, one more explanation, one more attempt to be sure. Rumination can feel like problem-solving while keeping the original doubt open.

item.title: OCD vs Anxiety: Why the Pattern Matters
item.description: Anxiety can occur within OCD and alongside it. Looking at what happens after a thought appears helps explain why the distinction matters for treatment.
